name: Music Positive and Risky Message Assessment Benchmark
description: In this work, we introduce a pioneering research challenge: evaluating positive and potentially harmful messages within music products. We initiate by setting a multi-faceted, multi-task benchmark for music content assessment. Subsequently, we introduce an efficient multi-task predictive model fortified with ordinality-enforcement to address this challenge. Our findings reveal that the proposed method not only significantly outperforms robust task-specific alternatives but also possesses the capability to assess multiple aspects simultaneously. Furthermore, through detailed case studies, where we employed Large Language Models (LLMs) as surrogates for content assessment, we provide valuable insights to inform and guide future research on this topic. The code for dataset creation and model implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/RiTUAL-UH/music-message-assessment.
reputation: New, narrowly adopted dataset (2023) introduced for music content moderation research with code released but limited community uptake so far.
notes: Small / specialized dataset with subjective annotations (harmfulness/positivity) and potential labeling bias; contains multi-task and ordinal labels; some experiments use LLMs as surrogate annotators which may introduce contamination or domain transfer caveats.
